claim_scope: Exact convex-mixture criterion for one-qubit Clifford unitary channels after rotated-axis dephasing; arbitrary unitary Bloch rotation, unit axis, and probability in the closed unit interval.
integrity: All universal claims rest on an analytic proof; finite optimization checks are only corroboration. Prior aligned-axis thresholds and source rigidity lemmas are explicitly credited. Originality may be affected by unindexed convex-polytope face results.
scientific_limitations: Existence of exact stochastic Clifford-unitary mixture only; not nonunitary stabilizer instruments, nonzero magic cost, arbitrary circuit complexity, or hardware fault tolerance.
title: Cyclic-stabilizer polygon criterion for Clifford mixtures under tilted qubit dephasing
